author: Slidebean
description:
Elon Musk isn’t just launching products, he’s creating prediction markets.

With dozens of active bets tied to his deadlines, traders are effectively assigning odds to his ability to deliver.

That’s a new reality for high profile founders.

Promises don’t just shape expectations anymore.
They create tradable outcomes.

title: What prediction markets reveal about founder credibility
